view2: รายการประกอบแบบฐานรากแผ่ ข้อ 1-3 + '**กรณีดินใต้ฐานรากรับน้ำหนักบรรทุกปลอดภัยได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 10 ตัน / ตร.ม**' (split: notes)
warnings: Spread footings of the alternative system (S-01 boxed labels). Sizes 3.10/2.70/2.20 square; thickness tapers from 0.45 (0.35 for F3) at the column to 0.30 (0.25) at the edge — height_mm is the thickness at the column, edge thickness in the printed text.

Mat callouts are printed 'N-DBxxmm#'. '#' is read as a two-way mat with N bars each way, so main_bar.count = 2N with the printed text in count_printed_as (§0.5 two-way count rule); flagged because the '#' convention is not spelled out on the sheet.
Conflict: the third plan is titled 'แปลน F2' but its section is 'รูปตัด F3' and its size (2.20) differs from F2 (2.70); taken as F3 (section label + size agree, two marks against one).
